messages:
ava: Quick thread: SDK imports failing in Cloudflare + Vercel Edge when using the published package. Error: "TypeError: require is not defined".

devin: Hmm that screams CJS being resolved in an ESM-only runtime. Which package.json exports do we have?

ava: current excerpt:

```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
```

rachel: Many bundlers (some versions of esbuild/webpack/rollup) will rewrite or resolve to the require target if they see any CJS-ish metadata. Also edge runtimes don't provide `require`.

oliver: We saw a similar flake: retries/timings differed in edge vs node because the CJS bundle pulled in `node-fetch` shim with a different timeout wrapper. Auth refresh tests failed intermittently.

devin: Workarounds: 1) import from the ESM path directly: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference/dist/esm'` 2) add an alias in bundler to point to the ESM file. Both suck for DX.

ava: I prototyped a safer conditional export shape that adds a `worker` target and explicit `./types` entry so TS picks it up without relying on root `types` only. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1278 (WIP).

rachel: Also consider adding `typesVersions` in package.json for older TS resolver compatibility. I've pasted a snippet in the PR.

oliver: Another item: our runtime polyfills behave slightly differently between builds. We should centralize fetch/retry logic and ensure both outputs import the same small runtime adapter rather than bundling two different shims.

ci-bot: CI job created: `edge-smoke-miniflare` (runs quick miniflare boot + sample import) - queued.

devin: Long-term opinion: prefer ESM-first publish with a thin CJS bridge (generate CJS that re-exports ESM via `createRequire` or use `module.createRequire`). Fewer surprises for edge/modern bundlers.

ava: Agreed. Action list I added to the PR:
- add `worker` conditional export
- export `./types` and add `typesVersions`
- extract runtime adapter so both bundles share auth/retry
- add miniflare smoke CI
- update onboarding docs with edge notes

docs-bot: Added docs note: "Edge runtimes: use ESM entrypoints; see SDK troubleshooting for conditional exports and bundler overrides" :information_source: 

rachel: I'll own the typesVersions follow-up and a tiny e2e that runs `tsc --noEmit` against the package to validate types entry points.

ava: Thanks. If anyone hits further edge import weirdness please drop repro sandbox link (Glitch/StackBlitz) and tag me.

oliver: Also ping @security about shipping the adapter change to be sure no sensitive headers accidentally get proxied in edge adapters.

ci-bot: edge-smoke-miniflare finished: failure on one matrix entry (esbuild@0.18). Created ticket #3102.

ava: noted, will triage tomorrow.
